card.name: Festejo
card.profile: Afro-Peruvian festive music-and-dance developed by enslaved West Africans; no musical example predates 1800 and the modern form is a mid-20th-c. reconstruction — original choreography largely lost by ~1900, standardized from 1949 with revival by José Durand, Porfirio Vásquez and Nicomedes & Victoria Santa Cruz. Dual music+dance.
